Agents by Engineering the System, Not the Model</div></div><div class="c-content-card_row_text-wrapper"><div class="c-text-6">Agent reliability doesn&#x27;t come from picking the right model, it comes from engineering the system around it. Learn what harness engineering is, how to classify and fix agent failures, and how to build production-grade agent harnesses with Haystack.</div></div></div><div class="c-filter-mult-ref_collection <script>
(function(){
  function addScript(key, src, module) {
    const s = document.createElement("script");
    if (module) s.setAttribute("type", "module");
    s.setAttribute("src", src);
    s.defer = true;
    document.body.appendChild(s);
    const event = new Event(`${key}ScriptLoaded`);
    s.onload = () => document.dispatchEvent(event)
  }
  
  function persistModeInUrl(mode){
    document.querySelectorAll("a").forEach((link) => {
      const href = link.getAttribute("href");
      if (href && !href.includes(mode)) {
        const separator = href.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
        link.setAttribute("href", href + separator + mode);
      }
    });
  }
  
  const DEBUG_URL = 'https://localhost:3000'
  const STAGE_URL = `Vercel's staging url` //DO NOT MODIFY THIS URL IF YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING
  const PRODUCTION_URL = `Vercel's production url` //DO NOT MODIFY THIS URL IF YOU DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING
  const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
    DEBUG_URL,
    STAGE_URL,
    PRODUCTION_URL,
  ];
  const url = new URL(window.location)
  const urlParams = url.searchParams;
  const debug = urlParams.get("debug");
  const remoteDebug = urlParams.get("remoteDebug")
  const preview = urlParams.get("preview")
  const isStage = url.host.match(/webflow\.io/)
  
  function isTrustedOrigin(url) {
    try {
      return ALLOWED_ORIGINS.includes(new URL(url).origin);
    } catch { return false; }
  }
  
  if (!isStage){
    // [!] Uncomment this line after updating vercel and remove the other line
    //addScript('main', `${PRODUCTION_URL}/main.js`, true);
    addScript('main', 'https://deepset-custom-code-one.vercel.app/main.js', true)
    return
  }
  
  if (debug !== null) {
    addScript('client', `${DEBUG_URL}/@vite/client`, true);
    addScript('main',`${DEBUG_URL}/src/main.js`, true);
    persistModeInUrl('debug=true');
    return;
  }
  
  if(remoteDebug && isTrustedOrigin(remoteDebug)){
    addScript('client', `${remoteDebug}/@vite/client`, true)
    addScript('main', `${remoteDebug}/src/main.js`, true)
    persistModeInUrl(`remoteDebug=${remoteDebug}`);
    return;
  }
  
  if(preview && isTrustedOrigin(preview)){
    addScript('main', `${preview}/main.js`, true);
    persistModeInUrl(`preview=${preview}`);
    return;
  }
  // [!] Uncomment this line after updating vercel and remove the other line
  //addScript('main', `${STAGE_URL}/main.js`, true);	
  addScript('main', 'https://deepset-custom-code-one.vercel.app/main.js', true)
})()

</script></body></html><!--/$-->
